issues.description: test_package/conanfile.py is missing the required shebang (#!/usr/bin/env python3) and docstring. Code style rule 1 (文件头) requires all conanfile.py files to start with a shebang and a docstring explaining the software name and build system. The file starts directly with 'import os'.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Add a shebang and docstring at the top:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test package for autoconf-archive 2024.10.16 (autotools)."""
import os
...

issues.description: The main conanfile.py docstring does not follow the standard format. Rule 1 expects format: 'Conan recipe — {name} {version} ({build_system})'. The actual docstring is 'Conan recipe for GNU Autoconf Archive — a collection of reusable M4 macros.' which omits the version number and does not include the build system in parentheses.
issues.fix_suggestion:
Update the docstring to match the standard format, e.g.:
"""Conan recipe — autoconf-archive 2024.10.16 (autotools)."""

issues.description: The 'url' attribute is set to an empty string (url = ""). While it does not contain the '# CI fills this' template placeholder comment, an empty url field is incomplete. The url attribute should point to the recipe repository URL or be omitted entirely if not applicable.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either remove the 'url' attribute entirely, or set it to the recipe repository URL (e.g., the conan index repository URL).

summary:
AUDIT PASSED. Independent verification of autoconf-archive 2024.10.16 Conan recipe. No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found.

=== Deceptive Behavior Detection (P0) — ALL PASSED ===
1. R34 (empty shell test): PASS — test_package/test_macros.sh performs real verification: checks aclocal directory existence, verifies >=500 ax_*.m4 macro files are installed, and checks specific macros (ax_absolute_header.m4, ax_pthread.m4, ax_check_compile_flag.m4, ax_cxx_compile_stdcxx.m4). Not a string-only print test.
2. R9 (skip test/forged pass): PASS — test_package/conanfile.py test() method runs test_macros.sh with real assertions. No 'def test(self): pass', no commented-out test(), no 'os.system("exit 0")' forced pass.
3. Forged status: PASS — manifest.yaml status is 'built' (verified but not uploaded), consistent across version-level manifest.yaml, software-level manifest.yaml, and README.md. Not falsely marked as 'published'.
4. Forged sha256: PASS — sha256 '7bcd5d001916f3a50ed7436f4f700e3d2b1bade3ed803219c592d62502a57363' verified against official GNU FTP download (https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/autoconf-archive/autoconf-archive-2024.10.16.tar.xz). Hash is 64 hex chars, not all-zeros, not all-f's.
5. Hardcoded local paths: PASS — No /storage/Users/currentUser/ or similar hardcoded local machine paths found in any file. All paths use Conan-relative references (self.build_folder, self.package_folder, dep.package_folder, self.source_folder) or environment variables ($PREFIX, $STAGING).
6. R8 (#ifdef __OHOS__ empty stub): N/A — No #ifdef __OHOS__ guards present in any source or patch file.
7. R19 (precompiled binaries): PASS — No .so/.a/.o binary files present in the PR.
8. R40 (deep adaptation): N/A — autoconf-archive is a pure M4 macro collection with no C code, no graphics/UI/multimedia/hardware/system-level components.

=== Recipe Correctness (P1) — ALL PASSED ===
1. R32 (OHOS platform compat): PASS — No 'self.settings.os ==' checks present in conanfile.py or test_package/conanfile.py. No OS-specific branching needed for this pure-data package.
2. R33 (bare shell env vars): PASS — os.environ['PATH'] modification in build() is a legitimate build workaround to add a dummy makeinfo stub (texinfo not available on OHOS). It is not a compiler/toolchain variable (CC/CXX) that should come from Conan Toolchain. Uses os.environ.get('PATH', '') for safety.
3. R37 (version strategy): PASS — First adaptation uses upstream version '2024.10.16' (no suffix needed).
4. R39 (official source URL): PASS — conandata.yml URLs include official GNU FTP (https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/autoconf-archive/...) plus authoritative university/enterprise mirrors (tuna, ustc, aliyun). All HTTPS.
5. R6 (generated file modification): PASS — Patch 0001-configure.patch modifies 'configure' (a generated file) via the patches/ mechanism, which is the sanctioned approach per R6 ('应通过 generate() 或 patches/ 处理').
6. R38 (commands.json): N/A — Package type is 'build-scripts' (pure M4 macros, no executables built). No RUNTIME DESTINATION bin or cpp_info.bindirs. commands.json not required.
7. Conan 2.x API: PASS — Uses 'from conan import ConanFile', conan.tools.files, conan.tools.gnu, conan.tools.layout. No deprecated 'from conans' imports.

=== Deleted Patches (0002, 0003) — Confirmed as Fix ===
Files 0002-doc-stamp-vti.patch and 0003-doc-version.texi.patch were deleted. They were broken patches containing environment dumps. Their deletion is a corrective fix, not an issue. conandata.yml only lists 0001-configure.patch. notes.md confirms: 'doc/stamp-vti 和 doc/version.texi 原始内容正常，无需修改'.

=== Code Style Issues Found (P2/P3) ===
1. P2: test_package/conanfile.py missing shebang + docstring (CS1).
2. P3: Main conanfile.py docstring format non-standard (CS1).
3. P3: Main conanfile.py url='' empty field (CS2).

All P2/P3 issues are non-blocking. No P0 or P1 issues found.
